title: spellbookframe
summary: MSUI opens and toggles the spellbook through the bounded host-confirmed adapter, emits the frozen open/close/page-turn cues, renders the centered 36x36 Cooldown child and narrow IsCurrentCast checked ring, exposes all eight skill tabs, and reproduces left/right cast, shift-pickup, raw MacroFrame /cast append, drag-start, and receive-drag cursor behavior. The packet's distinct pet-spell list is now retained and drives the exact bottom Spell/Pet tab pair, class-token title, pet-only 12-slot page, pet cooldown/active/autocast presentation, synthesized pet cast, pet pickup cursor and the distinct CMSG_PET_SPELL_AUTOCAST verb with same-frame bar-bit mirroring. The rich-tooltip difference remains under adjudication and implemented presentation still carries live verification debt.

openItems.text: Implemented but needs live-session verification. SetSpellbookOpen now plays igSpellBookOpen/igSpellBookClose on actual open-state transitions and DrawPageButton plays igAbiliityPageTurn on enabled page clicks, through the shared PlayUiSound path with law-owned cue constants.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. Normal P binding and microbutton opens now use the host-confirmed Character/SpellBook replacement pair; close remains surface-owned, and each visible draw derives current tabs, spells, page bounds, title, and buttons from live state.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI's visible immediate-mode draw re-reads current eligible spells, names, ranks, passive state, and icons each frame, covering the XML-visible refresh result without claiming its event engine.
The frozen XML registers cooldown refresh and declares a centered 36x36 Cooldown child, while current DrawSpellButton renders no cooldown child.
Skill-line tabs have a checked ring, but spell buttons do not render the frozen current-cast/current-form checked overlay.

MSUI diverges from Benilla — decide: port Benilla behavior, or record a decision preserving MSUI (only allowed if UI/graphics). Spell buttons and skill-line tabs publish through the shared GameTooltip owner arbitration, but MSUI deliberately retains its existing rich spell tooltip and right-column rank presentation.
Current DrawSpellButton does not reproduce the frozen shift-click pickup/macro-append branch or full receive-drag contract.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI preserves the frozen two-column six-row grid, background/ring/icon layering, normal/pushed/hover art, name/rank anchors, passive ring/name treatment, and exact slot geometry.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI clamps page state per selected skill line, shows the frozen page label and arrow geometry/art, disables boundary arrows, and advances only enabled buttons.
Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI preserves the frozen right-rail tab background, icon, selected and hover overlays, tooltips, 49-unit stride, and all eight declared tab seats.
The frozen window declares eight skill-line tab seats, while current SpellbookLaw.MaxClassTabs is four and DrawSpellbook truncates the model.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI preserves the 384x512 left-window content, icon and four quadrant layering, title/page typography anchors, exact close-button geometry/art, and close through the native setter.
Cooldown child overlay, checked overlay, shift-click behavior, and tabs 5-8 (blocked on unpromoted dependency packets).

Live-verify Shift-P and the bottom tab switch with hunter and warlock pets: Pet/Demon titles, hidden skill-line rail, packet-list ordering, passive presentation, pet-bank cooldowns, active-aura ring/icon, pickup into the pet bar, off-bar casting, right-click autocast and same-frame sparkle mirroring. The focused clinical check covers the geometry, add-gate, packet layout and state laws without claiming a live capture.
